create_pid_agent: create a PIDAgent with proportional, integral, and derivative control coefficients for a control system
act_pid_agent: compute a PID control action from an observation using the PIDAgent act method
reset_pid_errors: reset the internal previous and cumulative error state of a PIDAgent instance
get_pid_parameters: get all PID controller parameters stacked and flattened into a single numpy array
get_pid_errors: retrieve the previous error and cumulative error arrays from a PIDAgent instance
